corewriter_action_accepted.meaning: a CoreWriter action sent by executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() was accepted locally while the corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist or is not yet active on HyperCore

pm_enabled.meaning: pmEnabled is true when executeHedge() runs

backing_reads_available.meaning: totalBackingSigned() and the accounting reads depending on it complete without reverting for the registered supplied-slot set
backing_reads_available.checkpoint: after the supplied slot is registered in the Accountant registry

core_accounting_reads_revert_observed.meaning: core accounting reads revert until the registry is manually cleaned up
core_accounting_reads_revert_observed.checkpoint: after the supplied slot is registered in the Accountant registry

registry_manually_cleaned_up.meaning: the Accountant supplied-slot registry has been manually cleaned up
registry_manually_cleaned_up.checkpoint: after the supplied slot is registered in the Accountant registry

claims.scope: MonetrixVault.executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() optimistically register a 0x811 supplied-balance slot in MonetrixAccountant after sending CoreWriter actions, without confirming the slot is readable on HyperCore

preconditions.text: A CoreWriter action sent by executeHedge() or supplyToBlp() is accepted locally while the corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist or is not yet active on HyperCore.; pmEnabled is true when executeHedge() runs.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: totalBackingSigned() and the accounting reads depending on it should remain available (not revert) for the registered supplied-slot set.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: core accounting reads revert until the registry is manually cleaned up
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The registered supplied-slot set includes the slot appended by notifyVaultSupply() after the locally accepted CoreWriter action.
The scenario is the report-supported conditional case where the 0x811 slot does not exist or is not yet active when the action is accepted locally.

limitations: Formalizes only the core_accounting_reads_revert impact; the potential protocol accounting/settlement availability impact is handled in a separate pass.
No authorization or caller qualifier is claimed because the report states none.
backing_reads_available and core_accounting_reads_revert_observed are qualitative Boolean observables pending code-level binding of the strict 0x811 read behavior.
The temporal qualifier 'until the registry is manually cleaned up' is encoded as registry_manually_cleaned_up being false at the revert checkpoint; the cleanup event itself is not otherwise modeled.
